title: Walkthrough feature descriptor (feature.yaml)
description: Source of truth for one feature walkthrough. The spec and narration are generated/derived from this; videos never explain implementation — every field is user-facing.

constants.description: Non-secret demo constants emitted as consts in the generated spec (e.g. REPO_NAME). Secrets NEVER go here — use auth.credentialsEnv.

businessValue.description: Why the feature exists, for the viewer.

userJourney.description: Ordered journey steps in user terms (navigation path).

mutates.description: true if recording changes real data — record-feature refuses without --allow-mutations.

stopBefore.description: Action the spec deliberately never performs, e.g. 'click:Review Code'.

reset.description: How to restore clean demo state (app's own tooling).

narration.description: Spoken line — product-demo voice, business language only.

guard.description: Human hint: what the shot depends on (documentation only).

guardExpr.description: TypeScript expression; when falsy the shot is skipped with a logged message (mark happens inside the guard).

action.description: Human summary of the interaction (documentation only).

steps.description: Structured interaction steps. Each step is one op: {goto|click|glide|scroll|type|assertVisible|waitForURL|beat|installCursor}. `scroll: <locator>` smoothly scrolls that element to center (reveal below-the-fold content). Locators use 'kind:value[:name]' — role:button:Sign In, placeholder:Email, label:Password, text:Foo.

custom.description: Verbatim TypeScript shot body for interactions the step language can't express. Shares scope with earlier shots.

holdMs.description: Closing beat in ms after the shot's steps so the narration can finish (default 2200). steps shots only — custom shots pace themselves.

assert.description: What proves the shot's end state rendered (documentation; enforce via steps/custom).

specHash.description: Hash of walkthrough.spec.ts at last recording — staleness detection.

generatedSpecHash.description: Hash of walkthrough.spec.ts as last generated (stamped by generate-feature). record-feature refuses to record when the on-disk spec differs — i.e. it was hand-edited or the yaml changed without regeneration.

contentHash.description: Hash of feature.yaml (excluding status) at last generation. Committed so catalog can detect yaml-vs-spec desync from a fresh clone, where mtimes are meaningless.
